'''Thall Joben's father''' lived with his [[Thall Joben's mother|partner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Beheboth]]. A champion [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]] racer, he was almost [[Death/Legends|killed]] in a crash two days before the [[Reproduction/Legends|birth]] of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall]]. Leaving the sport behind, he kept his past hidden from his son and years later refused to let Thall become a racer himself. A furious Thall stowed aboard a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] bound for the planet [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]]. Only upon his father's death, at some point prior to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]], did Thall return to Beheboth and learn about his father's former career.
